trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State intent to book an orthopaedic appointment.
steps.text: வணக்கம், நான் first time வர்றேன். எனக்கு orthopaedic doctor appointment வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Ask if the user has an existing patient ID.
steps.text: வணக்கம். நீங்க already patient ID வச்சிருக்கீங்களா?
steps.planner_rationale: Check if the user has a patient ID to look up their record.

steps.purpose: Provide patient ID.
steps.text: ஆமா, என்னோட ID PT-1003.

steps.purpose: Request identity verification factors.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்களோட identity verify பண்ண, உங்களோட registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்லுங்க.
steps.planner_rationale: Ask for identity verification factors before accessing the patient's record.

steps.purpose: Provide name and date of birth.
steps.text: என் பேரு ரமேஷ். Date of birth 15th May 1980.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using provided factors.
steps.planner_rationale: Call the verification tool now that the user has provided their ID and verification factors.

steps.purpose: Return identity verification result.
Look up patient registration status.
steps.planner_rationale: Fetch the patient record to check registration status and open appointments.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Inform user that registration is incomplete.
steps.text: Verification success ஆயிடுச்சு ரமேஷ். உங்களோட record check பண்ணதுல நீங்க இன்னும் full ஆ register ஆகலன்னு தெரியுது. Registration complete பண்ணா தான் appointment book பண்ண முடியும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user about their unregistered status based on the lookup result.

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on registration and how to book.
steps.text: Registration complete பண்ணணுமா? Registration னா என்ன? நான் தான் first time வர்றேன். அப்போ எப்படி appointment book பண்றது?

steps.purpose: Suggest counter registration and offer to check availability.
steps.text: நீங்க hospital counter ல வந்து register பண்ணிக்கலாம். ஆனா அதுக்கு முன்னாடி, orthopaedic doctor எப்போ available இருக்காங்கன்னு check பண்ணலாமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Offer to check doctor availability to provide informational value despite the inability to book immediately.

steps.purpose: Agree to check availability.
steps.text: Doctor எப்போ available இருக்காங்கன்னு check பண்ணலாமா? சரி, check பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Ask for the required timeframe to check availability.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must ask for the missing mandatory argument 'days_ahead' before calling the availability tool.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா. எத்தனை days குள்ள உங்களுக்கு appointment வேணும்? 3 days, 7 days, இல்லனா 14 days குள்ள வேணுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: Prompt the user for the timeframe since 'days_ahead' is required to check availability.

steps.purpose: Specify a 3-day timeframe.
steps.text: எனக்கு ஒரு 3 days குள்ள வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the next 3 days.
steps.planner_rationale: Call the availability tool now that the mandatory 'days_ahead' argument is provided.

steps.purpose: Return empty slots for 3 days.
Inform user that no slots are available in 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must state that no slots are available, directly reflecting the empty array returned by the tool.
steps.text: அடுத்த 3 நாட்களில் orthopaedic doctor slots எதுவும் இல்லை.
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user that no slots were found in the requested 3-day window.

steps.purpose: Request checking availability for 7 days.
steps.text: மூணு நாள் ல இல்லையா? அப்போ ஒரு 7 days குள்ள பாருங்க.
steps.clean_text: மூணு நாள் ல இல்லையா? அப்போ ஒரு 7 days குள்ள பாருங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: மூணு கால் ல இல்லையா? அப்போ ஒரு 7 days குள்ள பாருங்க.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the next 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: Check availability again with the new 7-day timeframe requested by the user.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for 7 days.
Provide available slot details and fee.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must quote the exact day, time, doctor, and fee returned by the tool without adding unverified details.
steps.text: அடுத்த 7 நாட்களில், Monday 10:00 AM க்கு Dr. Sharma இருக்காங்க. கட்டணம் 500 ரூபாய்.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the available slot details and fee exactly as returned by the tool.

steps.purpose: Request to book the offered slot.
steps.text: Monday 10 AM, fee 500 rupees ஆ? Okay, இந்த slot ஆ book பண்ணிடுங்க.

steps.purpose: Refuse booking due to incomplete registration and explain options.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கவும், உங்களோட registration இன்னும் complete ஆகாத காரணத்தினால், இப்போ book பண்ண முடியாது. நீங்க hospital app மூலமா register பண்ணலாம், அல்லது hospital க்கு நேர்ல வந்து register பண்ணலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: Refuse the booking request because the business rules prohibit booking an unregistered patient.

steps.purpose: Express confusion about app registration and ask for alternatives.
steps.text: App ல register பண்ணணுமா? எனக்கு அது சரியா தெரியாதே. அது எப்படி பண்றது?

steps.purpose: Explain the counter registration option.
steps.text: App ல பண்றது கஷ்டமா இருந்தா, நீங்க direct ஆ hospital க்கு வந்து counter ல கூட register பண்ணிக்கலாம். அது ரொம்ப easy ஆ முடிஞ்சிடும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Offer a non-digital alternative for registration to accommodate the user's low digital literacy.

steps.purpose: Confirm counter registration and ask if the slot can be seen then.
steps.text: Counter ல register பண்ணலாமா? சரி, நான் Monday நேர்ல வந்து register பண்ணிட்டு அப்படியே doctor ஆ பார்க்கலாமா?

steps.purpose: Confirm counter option but clarify the slot cannot be guaranteed.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent must not guarantee that the slot will remain available when the user arrives, as this is not supported by any tool.
steps.text: ஆமா ரமேஷ், நீங்க Monday நேர்ல வந்து register பண்ணிக்கலாம். ஆனா slot இப்போ book பண்ண முடியாதனால, நீங்க வரப்போ அந்த slot available ஆ இருக்குமானு நிச்சயமா சொல்ல முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: Confirm the counter registration option but clarify that the slot cannot be held or guaranteed without a booking.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the limitation and agree to visit in person.
steps.text: Oh, முன்னாடியே book பண்ண முடியாதா? சரி பரவால்ல, நான் நேர்லயே வந்து எல்லாம் பாத்துக்குறேன்.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient informed that registration must be completed before booking an available slot.
